content.value_statement: Authentication and authorization defects can expose accounts and sensitive data. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured auth reviews and remediation reports.
actual_capabilities: Reviews password hashing, storage, and reset flows for weak or unsafe patterns.
Checks JWT, OAuth, API key, and session handling against common security expectations.
Identifies broken access control issues such as IDOR and missing ownership checks.
Maps findings to OWASP, NIST, PCI-DSS, CWE, severity, and remediation guidance.
Produces structured security reports with priorities, impact, and suggested fixes.
limitations: It does not execute tests or prove exploitability without project access.
It depends on the code, logs, and architecture details provided by the user.
It cannot replace a full penetration test or formal compliance assessment.
It may miss runtime configuration issues that are absent from the reviewed materials.

use_cases.title: Review Login Code
use_cases.description: Find weak password handling, missing rate limits, session fixation, and account enumeration risks before release.

use_cases.title: Audit Access Control
use_cases.description: Check endpoints for missing ownership checks, unsafe role updates, and excessive permissions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Remediation Plans
use_cases.description: Convert authentication findings into prioritized fixes with impact, severity, and compliance context.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Auth Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small authentication flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this login and logout flow for authentication risks. Focus on password checks, sessions, rate limits, and clear remediation steps.

prompt_templates.title: JWT And Token Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this JWT implementation for signing, verification, expiry, issuer, audience, storage, refresh tokens, and sensitive claims.

prompt_templates.title: Authorization Endpoint Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of role and ownership checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these routes for broken access control. Identify IDOR, privilege escalation, missing ownership checks, and unsafe role changes.

prompt_templates.title: Compliance-Focused Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a security report for these auth findings. Include severity, CWE, OWASP mapping, impact, remediation, priority, and residual risk.

output_examples.input: Review a login route that stores passwords with fast hashing and lacks rate limiting.
output: Critical risk: password storage uses a fast hash that is unsuitable for user passwords.
High risk: the login endpoint has no throttling, so brute force attacks are easier.
Recommended fix: migrate passwords to Argon2id and add per-account and per-IP rate limits.

output_examples.input: Audit an API route where users can update another user record by changing the path identifier.
output: Critical risk: the route allows horizontal privilege escalation through a missing ownership check.
Impact: a normal user may update another account or change protected fields.
Recommended fix: require ownership or admin role checks before updating the record.

output_examples.input: Check a JWT middleware that decodes tokens before assigning the request user.
output: Critical risk: decoded token claims are trusted before signature verification.
Impact: an attacker could forge admin claims and bypass authentication.
Recommended fix: verify signature, issuer, audience, algorithm, and expiry before trusting claims.

best_practices: Provide the relevant auth code, middleware, configuration, and route handlers together.
Ask for severity, impact, exploitability, and remediation priority in the same review.
Review authentication and authorization together because failures often cross both areas.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on frontend role checks as the only authorization control.
Do not store secrets, JWT keys, or password reset tokens directly in source code.
Do not ask for exploit-only guidance without a defensive review and remediation goal.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, password handling, MFA, SSO, and access control patterns.

faq.question: Can it find OWASP access control issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It specifically targets broken access control, IDOR, privilege escalation, and missing ownership checks.

faq.question: Does it run security tests?
faq.answer: No. It provides code and design analysis based on the material you provide.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map findings to OWASP, NIST, PCI-DSS, CWE, and remediation priorities.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What input gives the best results?
faq.answer: Provide routes, middleware, models, token configuration, session settings, and authorization rules together.
